subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly China Southern via Guangzhou to Lijiang and stay five nights in 5★ hotels in Lijiang and Shangri-La. You visit Yulong Snow Mountain, Blue Moon Valley, Tiger Leaping Gorge, Dukezong Ancient City, Balagezong Grand Canyon and Baisha Ancient Town, with meal upgrades such as a Lijiang Royal Banquet with a Hanfu experience, and a Naxi dinner with bonfire party.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 7–12 2027 to Mar 5–10 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Guangzhou – Lijiang
items: Fly Manila – Guangzhou (08:20 – 11:00; on Jan 15 and Mar 5: 03:20 – 05:50), then Guangzhou – Lijiang (13:45 – 16:45)
Arrive in Lijiang and meet the tour guide
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Lijiang
items: Photo stop at Glacier Park (if the cableway is closed for maintenance or bad weather, the trip changes to the Spruce Meadow Cableway with a refund of RMB 60/pax)
Impression Lijiang song and dance show
White Water River / Blue Moon Valley (including shuttle cart)
Evening dinner at Lijiang Royal Bouquet with Hanfu experience and show

itinerary.title: Lijiang – Shangri-La
items: Tiger Leaping Gorge on the way (including round-trip escalators)
Shangri-La Dukezong Ancient City and Guishan Park
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Balagezong Grand Canyon
items: Balagezong Grand Canyon (including scenic area eco-friendly vehicles): Sutra Hall, Millennium Bodhi Tree, Bala Village, glass walkway, Echo Wall
Photo stop at Big Prayer Flags
Korean BBQ dinner or Tibetan hot pot
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Shangri-La – Lijiang
items: Yundi’an Coffee, a popular social media check-in spot (coffee at your own expense)
Naxi cuisine dinner with bonfire party (bonfire and folk dance may be cancelled in rain, no refund)
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Lijiang – Guangzhou – Manila
items: Transfer to the airport; fly Lijiang – Guangzhou (10:45 – 13:05), then Guangzhou – Manila (20:00 – 22:30; on Jan 7: 20:35 – 23:15)

placeDesc.Yulong Snow Mountain: A snow-capped mountain range north of Lijiang, also called Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Glacier Park: A high-altitude viewing area on Yulong Snow Mountain, a photo stop reached by cableway.
placeDesc.Ganhaizi: A high meadow at the foot of Yulong Snow Mountain with wide mountain views.
placeDesc.Impression Lijiang: A live song and dance show performed outdoors beneath Yulong Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.White Water River: A mountain stream near Lijiang with pale blue pools, visited together with Blue Moon Valley.
placeDesc.Blue Moon Valley: A scenic valley of turquoise pools below Yulong Snow Mountain, with a shuttle cart included.
placeDesc.Lijiang Ancient Town: A UNESCO World Heritage old town of canals, cobbled lanes and wooden houses.
placeDesc.Tiger Leaping Gorge: A deep Yangtze River gorge on the road to Shangri-La, reached with round-trip escalators.
placeDesc.Harmony Tazhongta: A stupa-style Tibetan Buddhist landmark visited on the way to Shangri-La.
placeDesc.Dukezong Ancient City: The old Tibetan-style town centre of Shangri-La, home to a giant prayer wheel.
placeDesc.Guishan Park: A hilltop park above Dukezong Ancient City in Shangri-La with a very large prayer wheel.
placeDesc.Balagezong Grand Canyon: A scenic canyon near Shangri-La with a Bodhi tree, a Tibetan village and a glass walkway.
placeDesc.Yila Grassland: A high grassland near Shangri-La, visited for its open pastures and mountain views.
placeDesc.Black Dragon Pool Park: A park in Lijiang with a pool that reflects Yulong Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Baisha Ancient Town: An old Naxi town north of Lijiang, quieter than the main ancient town.
